observations: The bitmap contains two material components on layer (1,0): a large closed rounded-rectangle loop and a separate straight bus waveguide along the bottom edge.
The guide/bus material width is about 0.52 um from the bottom bus and the top/bottom straight portions of the loop.

The loop is best interpreted as a racetrack/ring resonator side-coupled to the bottom bus. The resonator has long nearly flat top/bottom sections, short vertical side sections, and large rounded corners.
The bus spans essentially the full 30 um footprint width. The resonator outer top nearly touches the top of the footprint; its lower outer edge sits about 0.19 um above the bus.
topology_reasoning.working_principle: Light in the straight bus evanescently couples into the nearby closed resonator at the lower straight section. The resonator perimeter sets the resonance condition; the bus-to-ring gap and parallel coupling length set coupling strength; waveguide width sets mode confinement and effective index.
function_defining_knobs: coupling_gap: physical gap between bus and resonator
coupling_length: bus/ring parallel interaction span, expressed by the bottom straight length of the racetrack
corner_radius: bend radius and footprint curvature
delta_length: extra resonator perimeter length, implemented by widening the rounded rectangle so a +delta change adds +delta um of ring centerline length
topology_reasoning.implementation_plan: Use only parametric GDSFactory primitives: a gf.Path centerline for the closed resonator extruded to wg_width and a rectangular primitive for the bus. No device stencil components and no raw polygons.

iterations.change_made: Initial rounded-rectangle resonator with circular corners, 0.52 um guide width, 0.524 um full-width bus.
Tried elliptical corners with shorter top/bottom straight sections; rejected as worse because it underfilled the target shoulders while overfilling side arcs.
Replaced analytic loop with a simplified gf.Path centerline traced from the clean loop skeleton; set ring width to 0.514 um from measured area/length while keeping the bus rectangle at 0.524 um.
